usage.outputShape: body.markets[] (each: {venue, title, status, market_id|condition_id, market_slug, price?, volume?, end_time?}); body.query, body.count, body.venues_searched[]
quirks: inputSchema is empty in the registry but the endpoint REQUIRES a query string param ?q=<term>; pass the search term via ?q=, not a JSON body (it's GET).

Searches across multiple venues at once: kalshi, limitless, opinion, polymarket, predict. Each market's identifier field differs by venue (kalshi uses market_id string, polymarket/limitless/predict use condition_id hex, opinion uses numeric market_id).
price/volume/end_time fields are only present on some venues' markets.
usage.guide: Call GET https://blockrun.ai/api/v1/pm/markets/search with a ?q= query param holding your search term (e.g. ?q=bitcoin); payment is x402 USDC on Base, ~$0.005/call, no API key. The response is a single JSON object: read body.markets[] for the matched prediction markets across kalshi, limitless, opinion, polymarket and predict.fun. Each market has venue, title, status, a slug/id, and optionally price, volume, and end_time. body.count and body.venues_searched[] summarize the result set. Use the per-market market_id/condition_id/market_slug to drill into other /pm/ endpoints for that venue.
